item.tib: rig 'dzin gsang ba'i sgrub pa sku gsum dgongs pa las glud rdzongs kyi le'u
item.coloph: bdag 'dra bde chen gling pa rtsal gyis kong yul rong chen dbus phyogs dpal gyi gsang phug rdzongs (rdzong) nas spyan drangs te/ slar drag po g.yu mtsho mdangs ldan gling du shog ser la (las)bod yig tu bshus pa dge'o//
